_comment: Default housing configuration for M8. M8 runs pupitre + pigbrother + hybrid (resistive + superconductor insert). GR1/GR2 supplies are swapped relative to M9: GR1 = B supply (IB), GR2 = H supply (IH). voltage_channels_gr* contain ONLY the Ucoil source probes (UB/UH are derived via get_pupitre_voltage_formulas).
name: M8

IH.label: Insert Coil Current

IB.description: Lower coil current sum from DCCT sensors

Courants_Alimentations/Référence_GR1.description: Group 1 reference current sum from power supply outputs

_comment_voltage_mask: Run-dependent — may change between experiments. Keys are bare channel paths (no kHz/ prefix).
_comment_session_group: Hybrid current channel → supply group (EXPERIENCES_LOG ElecGroup). With a sessions log, the current is kept only inside a session of this housing on that group; the voltage mask is the fallback.
_comment_versions: Wiring changes over time, applied to the fields above by HousingConfig.at(). valid_from = start of the first pupitre file with the new wiring.

versions.name: M8-211225
versions.comment: From the first assembly commissioned in this housing (assemblies.commissioned_at; M8_A211225_00, Hybrid + M8Bitters, no insert). 12-slot pupitre (stale header HL-28_1_BI04_1_BE02_1_13/05/2014): M8Bitters read on Ucoil11/Ucoil12 (Icoil11/12 = IB), no Ucoil13-16 columns.

versions.comment: Back to the base wiring from the first 16-slot pupitre file (header M23012001), 2023.09.13 - 13:48:50: insert on Ucoil1-7, M8Bitters on Ucoil15/Ucoil16.
